description: This file defines the ClaimAttachmentDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. The class acts as a decorator for the ClaimAttachment entity, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve claim attachment data, including setting associated users and retrieving attachment content. It uses traits for authentication and ORM helpers.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around the ClaimAttachment entity, providing additional methods for user management and attachment handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a ClaimAttachment entity.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user of the claim attachment based on a user ID.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the attachment content as a string, reading from the attachment stream if needed.
